## Validation Checklist

- [ ] Experiment works in Chrome, Firefox, or Safari
- [ ] No browser console errors
- [ ] Documented test cases pass
- [ ] Theory section is at least 300 words
- [ ] Procedure contains at least 4 clear steps
- [ ] Simulation is interactive and produces visible output
- [ ] Quiz contains at least 3 questions with answer handling
- [ ] README contains input/output specifications and test cases
- [ ] Only `experiments/<my-experiment>/` was modified
- [ ] No edits to shared CSS, `js/common.js`, root `index.html`, or other folders
- [ ] Screenshot or demo video attached
